#    Workspace#twoTabs..., UiRedesign, UiLayoutMatrix, PlaceCard, AppearanceSettings (2), ImageViewer,
#    KeepsakeVisual, ReceiveAndPick#picker... (needs the system file picker), UiAppearance (its dock
#    "더보기" button reads as not displayed on the emulator; title and contrast checks pass)
